seeding.note: later training episodes reset without a seed and continue each environment's random stream

scopes.definition_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the declared term descriptions and the original-reward weight. It identifies what was declared, not what the term callables compute.
scopes.source_file_sha256: SHA-256 of the bytes of the file defining a callable, read at record time. It does not cover modules that file imports, data it reads, or interpreter and library versions.
scopes.source.revision: git revision of the checkout; it pins a callable's code only when that callable's file is tracked and unmodified.
scopes.legacy_terms_hash: schema-0 reward hash: the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over the same declared definition, kept so new records can be matched with older ones.

selection.meaning: the evaluated checkpoint with the highest mean ORIGINAL return on the validation seeds; ties go to the earliest checkpoint. Candidates are every scheduled checkpoint after training starts and the final one
